name: Weir
first_ground: 留白 is the first ground on Weir: the walkable pavilion, the valley, and The sounding weir. The sounding weir is 汀 Tīng’s place in 留白, not the name of this interface.
paths: Paths are relative to the site root, the directory that contains index.html. Join them to the site base URL. Do not resolve them from the host root.
place_assembly: A place response is the object at pointer inside href, plus id, resident, and entry from this entry. If that object has no scene and this entry has scene_format, add scene with that format. Name and description come from the resident record.
gates_source: gates/registry.json is authoritative for gates. This array repeats the live docks so one read can list everything.
